title: likh action
description: One likh command: hold the command key, say one of its phrases, and likh carries out its steps. See README.md next to this file.

name.description: What the pill and the Commands tab call it.

description.description: What it does, for ChatGPT when no phrase matched. Defaults to the name.

say.description: Phrases that run it. {name} is a slot: a list's name if [lists.name] exists, otherwise it catches the rest of what was said and must come last.

lists.description: Named lists for slots: [lists.site] github = "https://github.com". The spoken name maps to its value.

input.description: What else it reads, as {selection}, {clipboard}, {app}, {title}. The selection costs a Ctrl+C.

output.description: What happens to the last result: paste it, paste it over the selection, show it in the pill, or nothing.

confirm.description: Ask in the pill before running.

router.description: ChatGPT may pick it when no phrase matched.

timeout.description: Seconds a run step may take.

do.description: The steps, in order. Each [[do]] has exactly one key.

paste.description: Paste this text. Slots are filled in.

keys.description: Chords split by spaces, keys by +: "ctrl+shift+t enter", "play_pause".

open.description: A link, file or app. Spoken slots are URL-encoded; list values go in as written.

ask.description: A prompt for ChatGPT; its answer becomes {result}.

run.description: A program and its arguments, no shell and no slots. It reads LIKH_TEXT and the rest from the environment or stdin; what it prints becomes {result}.
